name: implement-done-closure-runbook-assistant
title: Implement DONE closure runbook assistant
description: Implement a host-neutral Lattice CLI DONE closure runbook/assistant capability from docs/requirements/decisions/done-closure-runbook-assistant-execution-plan.md. The capability must prevent agents from mistaking TEST PASS for DONE, stay read-only by default, reuse existing DONE pre-check/oracle logic, and keep local Non-authority lifecycle evidence separate from receipt-backed Authority Server proof.
